name: Seared Cod with Dill-Scented Couscous & Caper Ranch Veggie Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, dill, and salt, then stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add cod and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and quarter tomatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Drain and roughly chop capers. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes along with the carrots and dressing. Stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp capers
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
1 cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cod, salad, and couscous between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
